top_signals.title: Hamilton Lane’s Bell on Secondary Markets Opportunity
top_signals.summary: As U.S. mortgage rates rise above 7% for the first time in a couple of years, Elizabeth Bell, Co-Head of Real Estate at Hamilton Lane, discusses whether the broader real estate market has been written off amid a slow post-pandemic recovery, changing consumer spending and higher rates. Bell says the market faces risks from elevated interest rates and geopolitics, which weigh on investment and yields, but still offers opportunities. She speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
